text: Ndeentoro-ɗee lette ñalaande darnga rewde ko yamiraa e accude ko haɗaa, ndeen ñalaande fittaandu nafataa fittaandu hay huunde, ndu jaɓantaake tefande goɗɗo sonaa e yamiroore Alla, coodtiigu ko heewi fof jaɓetaake, ɓe ngalaa ballo ñande heen, so tawii tefoowo e coodtiigu ballo alah holno daɗirtee!
